final_message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. `postSlug` now removes accents from the title before passing it to the vendored `slugify`, which strips any non-ASCII character it sees. I left `vendor/` alone, as you asked.

`src/shop/product-url.js` also mentions slugs. I didn't check whether it calls the vendored `slugify` directly, in which case product URLs would still drop accented letters.
